bullets: Updated the referral ad message to offer custom themes and unlimited free coding instead of extra daily sessions.
Changed the referral ad link to direct users to the personal referrals page instead of the earnings section.
Added a Referrals page to the web settings search index, allowing users to find options for invite links, rewards, and history.
Fixed the code block display in the terminal so it correctly identifies unfinished blocks inside lists, quotes, or sentences.
Extended the cloud device connection lifetime from 60 to 180 seconds so brief network drops do not break the link.
Added a specific error message for web cloud runs that fail because the user's computer is unavailable.
Added a dynamic keyboard shortcut hint to the model picker that adapts to the number of models and reasoning options.
Added support for identifying untitled cloud chats with a new 'New chat' placeholder on both standard and personal device chats.
